scripts.dev: uv run python -m uvicorn backend.main:app --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir backend
scripts.db:upgrade: cd backend && uv run --no-sync alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: cd backend && uv run --no-sync alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.db:current: cd backend && uv run --no-sync alembic current
scripts.db:history: cd backend && uv run --no-sync alembic history
scripts.e2e:server: ENV_FILE=.env.e2e uv run --no-sync python -m uvicorn backend.main:app --port 8001
scripts.celery:worker: CELERY_CUSTOM_WORKER_POOL=celery_aio_pool.pool:AsyncIOPool uv run --no-sync celery -A backend.app.task.celery worker -l info --pool=custom
scripts.celery:beat: uv run --no-sync celery -A backend.app.task.celery beat -l info
